purpose: Baseline parser, feed, current, power-budget, and broadside-pattern coverage using the existing smoke deck.
expected_observables: input, radiated, structure-loss, and network-loss power
total broadside gain at theta 90 degrees and phi 0 degrees
invariants: opposite segments have equal current magnitude and wrapped phase
input power equals radiated plus structure-loss plus network-loss power
a perfect conductor has zero structure loss and 100 percent structure efficiency
the 11, 21, and 41 segment series has decreasing successive feed-impedance and broadside-gain deltas

reference_precision.policy: No external numeric literal is asserted; comparisons use the frozen qualification tolerance policy and emitted report precision.

permitted_evidence_sources: fresh internal NEC2DX report as secondary evidence only
